article.headline: Cesare Edwards scores 24 to lead Georgia State to 70-65 victory over Appalachian State
article.description: — Cesare Edwards scored 24 points to help Georgia State defeat Appalachian State 70-65 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Cesare Edwards scores 24 to lead Georgia State to 70-65 victory over Appalachian State
article.story: ATLANTA -- — Cesare Edwards scored 24 points to help Georgia State defeat Appalachian State 70-65 on Saturday. Edwards also had nine rebounds and three blocks for the Panthers (12-15, 7-7 Sun Belt Conference). Malachi Brown scored 11 points, shooting 3 for 7 (2 for 3 from 3-point range) and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line. Nicholas McMullen finished 5 of 6 from the floor and scored 10. Myles Tate led the Mountaineers (16-10, 9-5) with 16 points, seven rebounds, six assists and two steals. CJ Huntley added 14 points, 10 rebounds and two blocks. Dior Conners also scored 14. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
